own_deduction.premise: For valid R(x,w), WSign(wout,w,m) is correct for every message m
own_deduction.substitution: Use the same valid witness with BitcoinSignatureMessage(T_bad)
own_deduction.cost_scope: One valid-witness computation, one decryption, one ordinary signature; does not require retained setup state
own_deduction.limitation: Not an attack on the stated binary authorization functionality, or an impossibility result for message-bound constrained signatures
